# Security policy

PandaDeck's settings page only listens on `127.0.0.1` and requires a custom header; the panel's
Wi-Fi API requires its token. If you find a way around either, or any other security issue,
please **don't open a public issue**. Report it privately through GitHub's
[security advisories](https://github.com/wikydtron/pandadeck/security/advisories/new) instead.
You'll get an answer as soon as possible, and credit in the fix if you'd like.

Supported: the latest release.
